function.arguments: {"observation": "The `revenue` column contains thousands separators (e.g., '999,999.99'), which means it is stored as a string and cannot be used in numeric operations without cleaning. Further, six rows have `revenue = 999,999.99`, which are identified as internal QA orders and not real transactions.", "implication": "Any analysis involving revenue must first clean the string values by removing commas and converting to float. More critically, the six QA orders must be excluded from any count or aggregate computation involving revenue, as they are not real orders and would corrupt summary statistics. function.name: note_finding
